name: Language change
about: A new form, rule or library function

---

What a program can do with it that it cannot do now, as a short program:

```cairn
```

The elaboration: what it means in terms of forms the language already has, and when it is refused.

The cost boundary: which effects it adds to a row, and what it allocates, waits on or synchronizes.

The diagnostic code a wrong use is refused with, and an example of that use.
